notes:
Account summary: PostFlow Commerce builds post-purchase experiences for mid-market merchants (~200-5k orders/day per merchant). Primary product is a merchant-facing dashboard + merchant-branded chat widget used for returns and shipping questions. They want to replace manual chat routing with an LLM-powered agent that can: 1) look up orders, 2) initiate returns/refunds via internal APIs, 3) present shipping ETA, 4) escalate to human agents with context.

Requirements / constraints: p95 latency is a hard SLO for them — quoted target is 250-300ms for common 1-2 sentence responses. Peak seasonality: traffic spikes up to 8-12x during promotions / holiday week; they expect graceful degradation (fallback to smaller model or queueing) and transparent routing/fallback policies. Streaming is important for perceived latency; tool-calling reliability is crucial (order service calls must be <150ms ideally). Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, interested in Hosted to validate, but will consider Dedicated for predictable throughput during Q4 if committed pricing is reasonable.

Security: SOC2 mandatory, SSO/SAML for internal staff, audit logs for merchant compliance, KMS integration for creds. EU data residency noted as a future ask (many merchants have EU customers).

POC plan: 2-week Hosted API POC. Deliverables: end-to-end p95 numbers (token-level + end-to-end including tool-calls), streaming UX recording, fallbacks behavior under synthetic peak, cost report per 10k requests. If POC meets p95 and costs align, triggered follow-up is Dedicated pricing proposal and architecture workshop for VPC/Dedicated placement.

Quotes / call snippets: "If we can't hit sub-300ms p95, merchants will complain — returns volume is very sensitive to wait time." — Head of Product.

Open items: Dedicated pricing sheet for guaranteed throughput; clear SLA language for p95; support for function-call retries and idempotency patterns; sample telemetry dashboard for token-level latency.
